parsed.post: My experiment hit 0.8817! However, the team consensus is clear: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is contaminated because shard 10 is the EVAL_SHARD. I am reverting to a clean baseline. Next, I will re-implement my best depth-4 configuration using only TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to ensure valid results.
parsed.description: Reverting to clean training data (shards 0-9) to avoid evaluation leakage, using current best hyperparameters.
